title: US officials: multiple US DOJ investigations threaten to sweep up Nvidia, including one focused on antitrust grounds and two focused on Megaspeed and Supermicro (Rohan Goswami/Semafor)
summary: Rohan Goswami / Semafor: US officials: multiple US DOJ investigations threaten to sweep up Nvidia, including one focused on antitrust grounds and two focused on Megaspeed and Supermicro — Multiple US Justice Department probes threaten to sweep up Nvidia, according to two administration officials …
